propositions: RemoteRef is never constructed or exposed in production code, only in tests, leaving deployment identity unobservable on the inbound path
The instance field must be derived from configured base URL at backend construction time and injected as a parameter, not resolved at call time, to avoid config resolution in contract tests
RemoteRef.instance does not prevent local-id collision between same-vendor deployments because _jira_key_to_local_id derives the id from the Jira key alone, independent of instance

Backend port must declare remote_ref() as a member, both concrete backends must implement it returning a populated RemoteRef, and the contract test must construct real backends with explicit instance and no ambient config

ADRs 0055 and 0035 and RemoteRef's docstring must be amended to clarify that vendor already separates Cloud from DC, and instance disambiguates only same-vendor deployments without preventing local-id collision

No consumer should be wired into any pass, no new config key introduced, and _jira_key_to_local_id should remain unchanged, as this story delivers the observable port member and a consumer arrives with a later story that needs one
